court: In the High Court of Madras
judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Abdul Quddhose, J.:— The learned counsel appearing for the appellant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the Second Appeal and she has made an endorsement to that effect in the Court bundle.

2. Recording the submission made by the learned counsel for the appellant and the endorsement, this Second Appeal is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
